lead: Sunday mixed policy and builders: [Politico reconstructed the 85-day collision between the Trump White House and Anthropic](../summaries/da42475dac42.md), while [Jensen Huang argued that AI leaders calling for regulation want relief from existing laws](../summaries/b59a7088b4fa.md), not new ones. [Alibaba's Qwen team open-sourced Qwen-Image-2.1](../summaries/1ba4b92c727b.md), unifying generation and editing in a 7B visual model, and [Mini-AGI showed dynamic continual learning trained on 8GB of VRAM](../summaries/458d8111da3b.md). The labor thread ran deep too: [young people in China launched 7M+ one-person startups in 2025](../summaries/bec13b8d3c1c.md), up ~42%, turning to AI to escape a bleak job market.
